criteria.text: Multipart and raw manifest upload endpoints accept requirements.txt and package.json
criteria.proof: Verified by tests/test_manifest_api.py (test_analyze_raw_requirements_txt, test_analyze_raw_package_json, test_upload_requirements_file_multipart, test_upload_package_json_file_multipart) confirming multipart and raw JSON ingestion endpoints for both requirements.txt and package.json.

criteria.text: Dependencies safely parsed without code execution
criteria.proof: Verified by tests/test_manifest_parser.py (9 tests) verifying pure regex/AST parsing of exact pins, non-pinned constraints, environment markers, inline comments, flags (-r, -e, --index-url), URLs, and package.json dependencies/devDependencies without executing host code or subprocesses.

criteria.text: PyPI and npm registry clients query available versions with caching
criteria.proof: Verified by tests/test_registry_clients.py (10 tests) confirming PyPI JSON API and npm registry clients, in-memory TTL caching preventing redundant network queries, yanked/deprecation detection, scoped package escaping, and offline local catalog fallback.

criteria.text: Outdated packages classified into Up-to-Date, Upgrade Available, or Preserved
criteria.proof: Verified by tests/test_manifest_service.py and tests/test_semver_evaluator.py confirming deterministic classification into UP_TO_DATE, UPGRADE_AVAILABLE, and PRESERVED across Python and Node.js ecosystems.

criteria.text: Malformed manifests fail gracefully with diagnostic error responses
criteria.proof: Verified by tests/test_manifest_api.py (5 tests) confirming HTTP 422 diagnostic responses on malformed JSON and empty content, HTTP 400 on unsupported extensions, and HTTP 413 on files exceeding the 1MB cap.
